_note: Canonical animation-name → sprite map (sponsor-locked naming 2026-05-29). PixelLab does NOT export the semantic animation_name passed at generation; its metadata.json keys by an action-description slug + folder. This file is the authoritative map the webview trigger logic + manifest generator (scripts/build-sprite-manifest.mjs) consume. VALUE FORMAT: a bare folder name `<state_folder>` means that folder holds exactly ONE animation (resolve animations/<sole-slug>/south/frame_*.png — legacy default); a `<state_folder>/<anim_slug>` value names a SPECIFIC animation inside a folder holding MORE THAN ONE. active_work + active_read SHARE sitting_at_a_desk_fa (same desk posture → no book↔desk flip during active sessions), so both use the folder/slug form. Idle pool = all idle_* (webview picks at random). ACTIVE POOL (ticket 86ca3mge9): for running + tool != Read the webview now picks ONE of `active_pool` (typing / work_cycle / work_focus, baked on new grounded mouse-desk poses) per active EPISODE and loops it, mirroring idle-episode stickiness; active_work remains the single-pose fallback for a character with no active_pool. active_read (tool == Read) is unchanged and never pool-drawn.
_playback_note: Per-animation playback tuning (anim-playback epic E2, 86ca2187g). Keyed by canonical anim name (must exist in `animations`). Fields (all optional): speedMultiplier (fraction of default frame RATE; 0.5 = half speed = 2x per-frame ms), dwellFrameIndex (mid-sequence apex frame held longer), dwellMs (apex hold add-on), finalDwellMs (final-frame hold before loop restart; default 400), playbackMode ("loop"|"pingpong"; default loop), startFrame/endFrame (inclusive frame sub-window). Malformed values are dropped + warned by scripts/build-sprite-manifest.mjs (unknown playbackMode falls back to loop). Migrated from the former hardcoded PLAYBACK_OVERRIDES map (E2). Edit + `npm run build` + reload to retune — no TS edit.
